variants.prompt: REFORMED CAMERA ANGLE: Captured in an extreme close-up, the camera focuses on her face and decolletage as she looks straight into the lens, a sultry, inviting gaze lingering on the viewer. Her bright green eyes seem to sparkle with mischief, and her full lips are slightly parted, revealing the tip of her tongue. The shallow depth of field blurs the background, emphasizing the intricate details of her face and the delicate gold chain resting against her collarbone.
